# Test List: 001-zuraffa-7-family-alignment

## Outer loop: acceptance behaviors

One per acceptance criterion in `spec.md`.

| id | behavior | traces | state |
| -- | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| A1 | every family package declares the same `zuraffa` constraint, and that constraint admits the latest published `zuraffa` release. | AC-1 | PENDING |
| A2 | all five family packages resolve through one pub workspace, with one shared lockfile and one shared package configuration. | AC-2 | PENDING |
| A3 | the shared FFI contract (port, service, module, value, exception) and the DI registration are reachable from the package's public entry point. | AC-3 | PENDING |
| A4 | the conversion goes through the shared `zuraffa_ffi_platform` envelope instead of an adapter-local envelope implementation. | AC-4 | PENDING |

## Outer loop: widget behaviors

UI acceptance scenarios (bug #830): asserted through a testWidgets pair — a view-builder subject stub plus a widget test that pumps the view and asserts the scenario.

The `kind` cell is the finder-kind taxonomy (issue #1140): the scenario verbs' predicted assertion classes — presence, absence, route-outcome, enabled-state, sequence — or `none` when no finder is derivable. `zfa tdd gen` selects the assertion template by it and refuses a row whose kind column drifted from the scenario prose; verify-red's kind gate (issue #959/#964) certifies on the same vocabulary.

| id | behavior | kind | traces | state |
| -- | -------- | ---- | ------ | ----- |

## Inner loop: unit behaviors

One per functional requirement in `spec.md`.

| id | behavior | traces | state |
| -- | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| U1 | All five family packages MUST declare the same `zuraffa` dependency constraint. | FR-001, DependencyManifest.resolve | PENDING |
| U2 | The family MUST resolve through a single pub workspace rooted at the repository root, so one `pub get` serves every member. | FR-002, DependencyManifest.resolve | PENDING |
| U3 | The app-facing package MUST export the shared FFI contract and its DI registration from its public entry point. | FR-003, FfiContract.exports | PENDING |
| U4 | Each adapter package MUST register its platform port on the DI container, leaving the service typed and unwired when no channel is injected. | FR-004, FfiRegistration.register | PENDING |
| U5 | Adapter packages MUST NOT declare their own channel envelope; the shared envelope in `zuraffa_ffi_platform` MUST be the only implementation. | FR-005, PlatformFfiEnvelope.call | PENDING |
| U6 | The publish pipeline MUST strip workspace-only pubspec fields from the published packages, so a published member never carries workspace resolution. | FR-006, PublishPipeline.prepare | PENDING |
